atelier.hero.title:
Websites with
character.
atelier.hero.copy: Thoughtfully designed. Carefully built. We make websites that feel like you—and work for the people who use them.
atelier.hero.location: A SMALL STUDIO IN ISTANBUL. OPEN TO THE WORLD.
atelier.intro.label: HELLO, WE’RE ATASHALCI LABS.
atelier.intro.title:
A good website
makes you feel something.
atelier.intro.small:
A clear idea. A little character.
A lot of attention to detail.
atelier.intro.copy: We bring design and development together to turn what makes your business different into a website people can understand, enjoy and use. Our focus is simple: beautiful websites, built properly.
atelier.services.label: WHAT WE DO
atelier.services.title:
From first idea
to the final full stop.
atelier.services.intro: A new beginning or a fresh direction for your existing site. We work on the story, the design and everything that makes it run.
atelier.services.cta: Tell us what you have in mind
atelier.service.1.title: Web design
atelier.service.1.copy: A visual direction that belongs to your business. We shape the content, structure and interface so visitors know who you are and where to go next.
atelier.service.1.list:
• Brand & business websites
  • Landing pages
  • Portfolio & editorial websites
  • Website redesigns
atelier.service.2.title: Web development
atelier.service.2.copy: We turn the design into a fast, responsive website. Clear structure, accessible controls and attention to the details that matter on every screen.
atelier.service.3.title: A little extra character
atelier.service.3.copy: Sometimes a well-judged interaction tells the story better. We add movement and original details where they make the website clearer, more useful or more memorable.
atelier.service.3.list:
• Art direction for the web
  • Interactive typography
  • Motion & micro-interactions
  • Creative web experiences
atelier.studies.label: THE STUDIO SKETCHBOOK
atelier.studies.title:
A little room
to play.
atelier.studies.copy: Self-initiated website explorations. Small studies in typography, layout and interaction—not commissioned client work. Try the details for yourself.
atelier.study.1.title: An editorial eye.
atelier.study.1.copy: For stories worth spending time with. A study in rhythm, bold type and a changing visual theme.
atelier.study.2.title: Space to breathe.
atelier.study.2.copy: For a considered first impression. An architectural composition that changes with the light.
atelier.study.3.title: A different kind of hello.
atelier.study.3.copy: For a launch with a point of view. One message, three moods. See how colour and type change its character.
atelier.editorial.title:
Everyday,
extraordinary.
atelier.editorial.status: 01 / 03 — Change the composition with the arrow.
atelier.editorial.feedback: {number} / 03 — A new composition, the same page.
atelier.spatial.title:
Less noise.
More presence.
atelier.spatial.status: Change the light. Keep the structure.
atelier.spatial.nightStatus: After dark — the same composition in a new light.
atelier.expressive.title:
Hello,
possibility.
atelier.expressive.status: Choose a mood. Watch the character change.
atelier.expressive.feedback: Warm — rounded type and a sunlit palette.
Bold — strong contrast and a sharper voice.
Quiet — fewer colours, a softer pace.
atelier.process.label: HOW WE WORK
atelier.process.title:
Good websites.
Good conversations.
atelier.process.copy: You work directly with us, from the first conversation to launch. Clear steps, shared decisions and space to get the details right.
atelier.process.1.title: Get to know you.
atelier.process.1.copy: Your business, your audience and what the website needs to do. We start with questions, then agree the scope.
atelier.process.2.title: Find the direction.
atelier.process.2.copy: We shape the pages, content and visual language. You review the design before we start building.
atelier.process.3.title: Make it work.
atelier.process.3.copy: We develop the site and check how it feels on phones, tablets and desktops. You see it take shape.
atelier.process.4.title: Ready for the world.
atelier.process.4.copy: Final checks, launch and a clear handover. We discuss any ongoing support as part of the project scope.
atelier.studio.label: TWO PEOPLE. ONE STUDIO.
atelier.studio.title:
Small on purpose.
Personal by nature.
atelier.studio.copy: We’re Arda and Onur, the partners behind Atashalci Labs. An independent studio in Istanbul, bringing design and development into the same conversation.
atelier.studio.direct: No long chain of handoffs. You talk to the people making your website.
atelier.contact.label: SOMETHING IN MIND?
atelier.contact.title:
Let’s make
something yours.
atelier.contact.copy: A new website, a redesign or the start of an idea. Tell us a little about your business and what you need. A rough outline is a good place to begin.
atelier.error.title: A little off the page.
atelier.error.copy: This page isn’t here. Let’s take you back to the studio.
